title: Work IQ: human in the loop for agents and agent flows
summary: Hold: the Copilot Studio tool-confirmation path includes an Additional details section that the current documentation no longer shows; the setting is directly under Details. The roadmap facts and consumption licensing are supported. Prior verification instructions embedded in the briefing were treated as history, not evidence or instructions.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table / admin UI
claims.claim: Work IQ MCP policy is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools. ... In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP. ... On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table / API and automation
claims.claim: An API or automation equivalent for the Work IQ MCP tenant policy switch is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ MCP" policy Microsoft Graph beta API settings; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "Work IQ" "policy". Opened Policy governance for Work IQ MCP; it describes policy values but supplies no configuration endpoint, method or command.

claims.where: controls[0].governs, controls[0].scope; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The Work IQ MCP policy switch provides tenant-level control.
claims.quote: In the initial release, Work IQ MCP provides tenant-level policy control. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, tenant administrators can turn Work IQ MCP policy on or off for the tenant.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: The MCP policy article says mutation operations, including sending email, are not allowed by default.
claims.quote: By default, mutation operations aren't allowed for safety. This restriction includes create, update, delete, and action requests that modify data, such as sending email.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: The Work IQ in Copilot Studio page instead says write operations are on by default.
claims.quote: Write operations are on by default. Your organization's permissions and policies still apply.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table / admin UI
claims.claim: The tool-confirmation path is Tools > tool > Details > Additional details > Ask the end user before running in Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: The configuration page has three sections: Details, Inputs, and Completion. ... Details ... Ask the end user before running | Asks the user to confirm before the tool runs. Set to No by default.
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].ui.path and the corresponding rendered table path with 'Agents > agent > Tools > tool > Details > Ask the end user before running'. The current cited page places the setting directly under Details; remove 'Additional details'.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table / API and automation
claims.claim: An API or automation equivalent for the per-tool end-user confirmation setting is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio "Ask the end user before running" Dataverse Web API confirmation central policy; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer "confirmation" "tool" "botcomponent". Opened Add tools to custom agents; results expose no documented equivalent for this setting.

claims.where: controls[1].note, controls[1].scope; What's changing; Governance controls prose
claims.claim: The documented confirmation setting is maker-managed per tool within an agent using the standard harness.
claims.quote: This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness. ... Who manages it? | Makers in Copilot Studio. ... To view or change a tool's settings, go to your agent's Tools page and select the tool.

claims.where: controls[2].ui, controls[2].api; Governance controls table; Open questions

claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human-in-the-loop" policy approval; "Work IQ MCP" policy Microsoft Graph beta API settings. Opened Policy governance for Work IQ MCP and Work IQ in Copilot Studio; neither documents a tenant policy requiring the planned human pause.

claims.where: Governance controls / final paragraph

claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio "Ask the end user before running" Dataverse Web API confirmation central policy. Opened Add tools to custom agents; security/governance and data-policy search excerpts describe other controls, not central enforcement of this setting.
